integrity: The proof includes the exact conditional transition kernel, positive Yule degree martingales, diagonal predictable bracket, vanishing cross-brackets and a stable martingale CLT. Exact finite diagnostics are explicitly not infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: Classical single-edge zero-offset preferential attachment only; fixed finite deterministic birth labels; no growing-family or altered-kernel result; historical-priority risk remains for incompletely inspected stronger general CLTs.
title: Joint mixed-Gaussian leaf-neighbor fluctuations at finitely many preferential-attachment hubs
